_comment: NSE equity segment trading holidays (full-day closures on what would otherwise be a trading weekday). Cross-checked against three independent sources (Zerodha, ClearTax, Groww) on 2026-07-13; all weekday-vs-date pairings verified programmatically against the real calendar. Weekend-falling holidays (e.g. 2026-02-15 Maha Shivaratri, 2026-03-21 Eid-Ul-Fitr, 2026-08-15 Independence Day, 2026-11-08 Diwali Laxmi Pujan/Muhurat) are intentionally NOT listed here -- the market is already closed those days via the Saturday/Sunday check, so they don't affect is_trading_day() and including them would be redundant. Source of truth for future years: official NSE circulars at nsearchives.nseindia.com.
